Greptile Summary

 This PR establishes the full PostgreSQL schema, RLS policies, and TypeScript helper layer for OutboundAI, introducing tables for users, campaigns, prospects, generated emails, subscriptions, and usage logs, along with UI components and provider wrappers. - **Migration (`20240623000000_initial_schema.sql`)**: Defines all tables with RLS enabled, creates a `handle_new_user` trigger and `deduct_credits` function; several policy gaps remain (no INSERT on `usage_logs`/`subscriptions`, no `WITH CHECK` on the users UPDATE policy, no balance guard in `deduct_credits`). - **`src/lib/db/index.ts`**: Type-safe server-side helpers for every table; `getSubscriptionByUser` uses `.single()` without filtering by status, which will fail once a user has more than one subscription row. - **`src/hooks/use-supabase.ts`**: Committed as an empty file while the actual `useSupabase` export lives in `src/components/providers/supabase-provider.tsx`, leaving any import from this path broken at runtime.

Confidence Score: 3/5

The migration should not be applied without addressing the RLS gaps and trigger edge cases; the empty use-supabase.ts hook will cause runtime crashes for any consumer importing from that path. The migration carries multiple compounding issues: no INSERT policy on usage_logs means credit consumption is never recorded, deduct_credits can push balances negative, getSubscriptionByUser breaks when a user has more than one subscription row, and the handle_new_user trigger will fail (rolling back the entire signup) if a non-email auth method is ever enabled. The empty use-supabase.ts is a silent import trap. Together, these affect core billing and auth paths. The migration file supabase/migrations/20240623000000_initial_schema.sql and src/lib/db/index.ts carry the highest-impact issues. The empty src/hooks/use-supabase.ts should be removed or populated before any code imports from it.

Security Review

 - **Missing `WITH CHECK` on `public.users` UPDATE policy** — Without a post-update row check, a user can overwrite their own row's `id` column. If a valid `auth.users` UUID exists without a corresponding `public.users` profile (e.g., from a previously failed trigger), an authenticated user could redirect their profile to that identity. Adding `WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id)` closes this window. - No secrets are exposed in the diff; the OpenAI key is read from an environment variable.

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | supabase/migrations/20240623000000_initial_schema.sql | Initial schema with RLS policies, indexes, and helper functions — has several known issues: negative credit balances in deduct_credits, missing INSERT/UPDATE policies on usage_logs and subscriptions, handle_new_user null-email crash risk, and missing WITH CHECK on the users UPDATE policy. | | src/lib/db/index.ts | Server-side helper functions for all tables; getSubscriptionByUser uses .single() without filtering by status, which will error when a user has multiple subscription rows. | | src/hooks/use-supabase.ts | Empty file — useSupabase is exported from src/components/providers/supabase-provider.tsx; any import from this path returns undefined and will crash at runtime. | | src/hooks/use-user.ts | Client hook for user auth state; correctly imports useSupabase from the provider and sets up an auth-state subscription with proper cleanup. | | src/components/providers/supabase-provider.tsx | Properly typed Supabase context provider with auth-state listener and router refresh; exports useSupabase correctly. | | src/types/database.ts | Type-safe Database interface matching the migration schema; Row/Insert/Update types look correct. |
